title: InsertionOptions
description: Stage F output. Ranked set of options for handling the emergent activity within the current outage schedule. Each option is a distinct scenario (insert now, defer, pre-stage, add contingency, etc.) evaluated for critical path impact, resource feasibility, and regulatory clearance. Options with regulatory constraints that prohibit deferral are flagged and may not appear in the feasible set.

options.description: All generated options, including infeasible and regulatory-blocked ones. Ranked by risk_score ascending (lower is better).

option_type.description: insert_now: execute immediately at current insertion point. defer_to_post_outage: defer to next operating cycle or scheduled maintenance window. pre_outage_staging: retroactive recommendation — stage parts/resources to reduce execution time. add_contingency_buffer: add float buffer to protect downstream critical path. parallel_execution: execute in parallel with a non-conflicting task. scope_reduction: reduce scope to minimum required to address the immediate issue. escalate_to_management: risk or complexity exceeds outage manager authority.

title.description: Short human-readable title for this option (e.g., 'Insert now — non-critical path').

description.description: Full description of what this option entails operationally.

feasible.description: False if resource conflicts, technical constraints, or data gaps make this option non-executable.

infeasibility_reason.description: Required if feasible=false. Brief explanation of why this option is not executable.

regulatory_cleared.description: True if this option is compatible with all identified regulatory constraints. False means deferral or scope reduction would violate a TS, NRC commitment, or CAP action.

regulatory_block_reason.description: Required if regulatory_cleared=false. References the specific regulatory_driver from ActivityIntakeResult.

cp_impact_hours.description: Expected increase in critical path duration under this option using the p50 duration estimate. 0 for non-critical insertions.

risk_score.description: Composite risk score for this option. Lower is better. Combines CP impact, confidence, and resource conflict severity.

confidence.description: Confidence in this option's impact assessment.

rationale.description: Evidence-backed rationale for why this option is recommended or not, citing specific analogs, chain links, or schedule analysis results.

assumptions.description: Explicit assumptions underlying this option's feasibility and impact estimate.

evidence_refs.description: References to supporting evidence: analog IDs, chain link IDs, schedule task IDs.

recommended_option_id.description: option_id of the top-ranked feasible, regulatory-cleared option. Null if no option meets both criteria.

recommendation_confidence.description: Confidence tier of the recommended option.

options_regulatory_blocked.description: Number of options excluded because they would violate a regulatory constraint.

ranking_criteria.description: Ordered list of criteria used to rank options (e.g., cp_impact_hours, regulatory_cleared, confidence).

schedule_impact_assessment_id.description: run_id of the ScheduleImpactAssessment artifact used to evaluate these options.
